verdict.rationale: Semgrep ships AI features (AI-Powered Detection, Semgrep Assistant), so letting it consume external MCP servers' tools is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence shows it can act as an MCP client. The only MCP evidence (semgrep-probe-3) is an official MCP server that Semgrep exposes to other agents, which is the server role and does not count toward this client-side story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
